insertions.text: **王阳明整体整合完成，2026年10月7日。** 按 Ren「先完成王阳明」，[当前主文](theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-existence/unified-2026-10-05/WANG-YANGMING.md)将一体之仁、明德亲民、知行与工夫重构为有伦理内容的同一展开；原典的本然良知和造化强说完整保留。实践形成的目的、理解及整个后续生活进入评价，苏秦张仪及适应性控制竞争者阻止把成功影响等同仁。拒绝、自护与合理结束明确作为有待具体论证的现代扩展。[来源、反审及整合](_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/WANG-YANGMING-COMPLETION-INTEGRATION.md)与新增12项实际通过的 Lean 声明共同收束本轮；其中8项无命名公理依赖，其余仅使用明列的标准逻辑依赖。形式接口检验同一完整有限历史上的表示与共同响应条件，`Fits` 的伦理根据仍给定。**下一根本推论：**仁的整体实现何以具有跨不同智能形成史的实践效力；无假设普遍证明未完成。6日比较的独立患者／行动者主线作为历史分解保留，由本轮整体重构取代。

**王阳明整体整合，2026年10月7日；本轮完成。** [当前章](unified-2026-10-05/WANG-YANGMING.md)从明德亲民的一木本末、知行工夫的一事，说明仁如何贯穿生成树中的承受、理解、目的与回应。原典复核与控制竞争论证共同区分仁的实现和有效支配，保留差等、合理拒绝及自我照料的解释负担。新增12项 Lean 声明已实际检查；有限整体历史的表示准则不供应首个伦理根据。[整合与依赖范围](../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/WANG-YANGMING-COMPLETION-INTEGRATION.md)明确：完成原典约束下的整合，不等于证明本然良知普遍可靠，或完成一切智能的无假设伦理奠基。

**王阳明整体整合，2026年10月7日：** [完成记录](WANG-YANGMING-COMPLETION-INTEGRATION.md)、[原典](WANG-YANGMING-COMPLETION-SOURCES.md)、[反审](WANG-YANGMING-COMPLETION-REVIEW.md)和[数学接口](WANG-YANGMING-COMPLETION-MATH.md)接入[当前章](../../../../theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-existence/unified-2026-10-05/WANG-YANGMING.md)。完成一体之仁、知行与工夫的整体重构及实践／控制辨别；12项新增 Lean 声明实际通过，8项命名公理依赖为空，标准逻辑依赖和伦理参数明确保留。旧王阳明章按原字节保存。普遍规范根据仍是下一根本推论，不再把先验独立的患者—行动者分解当作完整阳明结构。

**2026年10月7日，王阳明整合已收束：** [当前王阳明章](WANG-YANGMING.md)以明德亲民、知行和工夫的同一展开接回本章，保留本然良知的原典强说，检验私欲、有效控制、差等及现代拒绝／自护扩展。新的整体有限历史接口已经 Lean 实际检查；其适切关系仍需实质辩护，不能将原典与形式的完成算作无假设普遍证明。详见[整合记录](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/WANG-YANGMING-COMPLETION-INTEGRATION.md)。

**王阳明优先收束，2026年10月7日：** [Ren 的原话](15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-07-wang-yangming-completion.md)与 AI 范围说明分开保存。[原典核对](../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/WANG-YANGMING-COMPLETION-SOURCES.md)记录《王阳明集》卷一、二、三、二十六相关直接阅读和限制；公开转录未作异本校勘，也未导入新的外部原件字节。旧王阳明章的原字节保存与新增形式记录见[整合](../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/WANG-YANGMING-COMPLETION-INTEGRATION.md)。

## Situated practice in the whole history — 7 October 2026

[SituatedPractice.lean](SituatedPractice.lean) reuses `GenerativeCore` and `CoupledOccurrence` to retain full finite event/state histories. It checks the exact common-continuation condition for a readout to support a robust feasible response, actual enactment, refinement, changed appraisals, and a pairwise-versus-joint compatibility boundary. This is a correspondence result, not a definition of true knowledge or proof of moral warrant; the whole-history `Fits` relation remains supplied. An empty suffix does not prove enacted stopping or its ethical correctness.

Run `python3 check_wang_practice.py`. The [fresh receipt](wang-practice-verification.json) verifies 37 audits across three modules, including 12 new declarations: 8 empty named-axiom dependencies, with the others using standard `propext`, `Quot.sound` or `Classical.choice`. Initial failed and final passing source/log snapshots are retained. [Mathematics and dependencies](../../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/WANG-YANGMING-COMPLETION-MATH.md) and [Wang integration](../../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/WANG-YANGMING-COMPLETION-INTEGRATION.md) state the original-text, reconstruction and universal-grounding boundaries.
